finding.statement: After an ambiguous timeout, retrying create with the same idempotency key returned the original resource in this synthetic API v2 run.

applicability.description: A create call timed out ambiguously and the retry used the same key.
conditions: The retry used the original idempotency key.
exclusions: The initial create outcome was known before retry.

evidence.excerpt: synthetic run success-1: timeout; retry with key K; original resource id returned
